diagnosis.what_happened: A blank line/empty paragraph was present between the bottom border of tables and their respective notes in Markdown source and DOCX output.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Inserting blank lines or calling doc.add_paragraph() between table containers and table notes detaches the note from the table, violating APA 7 table layout conventions and institutional visual standards.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Table notes must attach directly below the table without an intervening blank line in Markdown or empty paragraph in Word DOCX. In OpenXML, table notes should have 0-2pt space_before, seamlessly hugging the bottom border of the table.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Under APA 7 and institutional thesis formatting, table notes are an integral part of the table structure. Any intervening blank space disrupts visual cohesion and indicates flawed typesetting.

desired_behavior: Attach table notes directly beneath the table with 0 blank lines in Markdown and 0 intervening paragraphs in Word DOCX.
generalization: Never place blank lines or empty paragraphs between tables and table notes across any academic deliverable.

evidence.observed_value: Blank line between tables and notes
evidence.threshold_value: Zero blank lines between table and note
